text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's overwhelmingly dynamic 
stride, matched by Biko Pegasus's equally 
powerful running, stirred the crowd into a 
massive frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus were just 
as excited. Biko Pegasus in particular was 
overjoyed, having remembered her own way 
of running and giving it her all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Let's have an even, even more amazing 
race than today." Under that promise, they 
vowed to have a rematch in the upcoming 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen!
